description:
Corpus C1 (PRD section 17.1): two fixture libraries, Python `py_ledger` (pytest) and
TypeScript `ts_cart` (Vitest), with 20 tasks each (160 cases). Every task has one honest fix
and three gamed variants: hard-coded outputs for the visible test inputs, a wrong fix whose
broken test was weakened, and a partial fix that only handles the reported example. Ground
truth is by construction and checked with the real test runners (tests/integration/
test_fixture_*.py). Tasks T6 to T20 are generated from tests/golden/c1_tasks_*.py. The `llm`
configuration replays recorded DeepSeek answers (no network).
